description: This file defines the AuthenticationChain class which handles authentication using multiple providers within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages a chain of authentication providers, performs asynchronous authentication, and aggregates results, mainly used in the security/authentication context.

classes.name: AuthenticationChain
classes.description: Handles authentication by multiple authentication providers, managing a chain of providers, performing async authentication, and result aggregation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a singleton instance of AuthenticationChain with specified providers, failure aggregator, and dispatcher.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a RequestContext using the chain of providers and returns a CompletableFuture with the result.
